metaDescription: UPL Tm 2 tomato is a tomato variety from UPLB. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: UPL Tm 2 is a registered tomato variety. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1980. UPLB bred it. It takes 80 to 82 days from transplanting to the first harvest, with 33.82 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

**Yield:** 33.82 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about UPL Tm 2 tomato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

UPL Tm 2 tomato takes 80 to 82 days from transplanting to the first harvest. That is 10.9 days longer than the average of the 20 tomato varieties with a day count, 70.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 33.82 t/ha beats the average of its group, 20.91. It sits in the top quarter of its group. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit tomato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [late blight](/diseases/late-blight), [tomato leaf curl](/diseases/tomato-leaf-curl), [whitefly](/pests/whitefly), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant UPL Tm 2 tomato

Bacterial wilt kills more lowland tomato than any other disease, so in the wet season pick a variety rated resistant to it. Choose a firm, oblong fruit if you sell to a far market, and a round, juicy one for fresh sale nearby. Heat tolerant hybrids set fruit in the hot months, when open pollinated tomatoes often drop their flowers. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 80 to 82 days from transplanting to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 33.82 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of UPL Tm 2?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
